script.problem: It has 38 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Estate” and “keeps the accounts” may be unclear to a 10-year-old. Consider “property” and “keeps records of money.”
The definition makes overseeing servants, handling money, and keeping accounts sound like duties of every steward. These were possible duties, not necessarily duties of every steward.
In Daniel 1:11–12, the steward is put in charge of caring for four young men, not specifically managing a household or estate. The meaning does not clearly cover this use.
